codecs.original_source: armbian/linux-rockchip rk-6.1-rkr5; original import did not record its commit
changes: Directly maintain the four imported codec source files.
Keep one ES7202 and two microphone channels for W132D.
Make ES7202 reprobe safe and release codec clocks after component teardown.
Propagate ES7202 I2C failures through read-modify-write, mixer controls, mute, resume and component setup.
Add the everest,es7202 binding and guard the optional I2C ID in OF probing.
W132D native HCI transport and Marlin3E-only Park policy quirk.
Restore vendor setup on every Bluetooth power cycle; synchronize RX, reset notifications and SDIO callbacks with teardown, and unwind failed transport initialization.
Firmware buffer ownership, DT device registration and rfkill fixes.
Management key storage and bounds checks; install IGTK independently of data keys and preserve data cipher state.
Initialize Wi-Fi RX/TX before publishing channels, unwind allocation failures, and drain queued SDIO TX before teardown.
Handle every Bluetooth SDIO block with unsigned lengths; guard legacy WoBLE parsing and payload sizes, and defer HCI recovery until BSP reset completes.
Validate firmware ownership, short reads and packed image tables; preserve function-mask offsets when reloading a selected image.
Synchronize legacy reset callbacks with owner removal; return Wi-Fi TX nodes synchronously and stop the sender before channel rollback.
Bound Wi-Fi command and connection event parsing by received payload lengths; reject invalid peer indices and bound normal SDIO RX traversal.
Apply cfg80211 management registration bitmaps per interface; bound management-frame logging and avoid a shared log buffer.
Use compile-time firmware response buffer sizes instead of variable-length kernel stack arrays.
Integrate Linux 6.7 through 7.1 API adaptations; 6.19 changes already present behind version guards.
Omit unused embedded USB firmware and vendor utility programs.
Use the UWE5621DS source directory and board Kconfig option; preserve wire identifiers and module ABI.
uwe5621ds.hardware: UWE5621DS, as identified by the board maintainer
uwe5621ds.compatibility: Preserve verified module ABI and firmware paths: uwe5622_bsp_sdio, sprdwl_ng, sprdbt_tty. The maintained source directory and board option identify UWE5621DS.
